pages.title: Massless Alloy
pages.text: An alloy the Higgs field has been told to ignore. Its particles have no rest mass, so it should move at the speed of light, yet the bonds between atoms keep it in place. It weighs nothing at all and drifts in any breeze, which makes it very hard to set down.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Higgs Field Modulator, a Sterile Neutrino carried the neutronium's coupling to the Higgs field away, while a condensate kept the lattice together. When it finished, the scale read zero.
